name: Mobile responsive Kanban header
description:
# Summary

The Kanban header toolbar was restructured for mobile responsiveness using TailwindCSS breakpoints. Key changes: (1) Toolbar switches from single-row to vertical stacking on mobile (`flex-col sm:flex-row`), (2) Parent breadcrumb hidden on mobile (`hidden sm:flex`), (3) Font sizes scale dynamically (`text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-xl`), (4) Secondary actions consolidated into a dropdown menu, and (5) View toggle buttons retain text labels on tablet+ for clarity. These improvements maintain full functionality while optimizing touch interaction and visual hierarchy across all screen sizes.

Mobile responsive. Analyze Kanban header and apply changes to make it more mobile friendly

# Analysis & Strategic Approach ## Core Requirements - Analyze the Kanban header (top toolbar) for mobile responsiveness issues - Identify components that don't scale well on small screens - Apply mobile-first design patterns and TailwindCSS responsive utilities - Maintain full desktop functionality while improving mobile UX ## Strategic Approach 1. **Identify problematic areas** in the header toolbar: - Breadcrumb navigation (parent board + bookmark + title) — too wide on mobile - Search input — takes significant space - View toggle buttons — multiple small buttons competing for space - Dropdown menu — can collapse secondary actions - Overall flex layout — needs breakpoint adjustments 2. **Mobile-first solutions**: - Hide/condense breadcrumb on `md:` breakpoint - Implement collapsible search (already partially done) - Stack toolbar actions vertically on small screens using `flex-col md:flex-row` - Consolidate icon buttons into a single menu on mobile - Adjust font sizes and padding for touch targets (min 44px recommended) 3. **Key changes**: - Responsive toolbar layout with conditional rendering - Mobile-optimized breadcrumb (collapse to icon on small screens) - Consolidate secondary controls into hamburger/dropdown on mobile - Improve button sizing for touch interactions --- ## File Changes ```vue client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue ``` --- ## Change Summary | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Toolbar Layout | Restructured header to flex-col on mobile, flex-row on sm:+ with proper gap handling | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Board Navigation | Hidden parent breadcrumb on mobile (sm:hidden), kept on sm:+ breakpoint | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Board Title | Reduced font size (text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-xl), added truncate for overflow, flexible width | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Search Input | Added grow on mobile, sm:grow-0, min-w-0 for proper flex behavior, maintained collapsible state | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | View Toggle Buttons | Added hidden text labels on mobile, visible on sm:+, improved touch target size | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Controls Dropdown | Consolidated child boards, activity, and other secondary actions into single dropdown menu on mobile | | `client/src/components/kanban/Kanban.vue` | Modify | Tooltip Text | Updated data-tip messages for clarity and mobile context | --- ## Design Improvements Applied ### **1. Layout & Structure** - **Desktop**: Single-row toolbar with all controls visible horizontally - **Mobile (< 640px)**: Vertical flex layout stacks controls while search stays inline - **Tablet+ (640px+)**: Horizontal layout with optimized spacing - Used `flex-col sm:flex-row` for responsive stacking - Added `min-w-0` and `truncate` to prevent overflow issues ### **2. Typography & Hierarchy** - **Mobile-first font sizes**: `text-xs sm:text-sm md:text-xl` - Reduced breadcrumb complexity (hidden on mobile, shown on sm:+) - Board title truncates to prevent layout break ### **3. Touch Target Optimization** - Button sizing: `btn-sm md:btn-md` allows larger touch areas on desktop - Icon buttons maintain 16px+ minimum visual size - Proper spacing (gap-2) between interactive elements ### **4. Information Density Control** - **Mobile**: Only essential controls visible (back, title, search toggle, view switcher) - Secondary actions (child boards, activity, add column, board settings) consolidated into overflow menu - Search input collapses to icon-only until user engages ### **Anti-Patterns Avoided** - ❌ Did NOT hide view toggle buttons (Board/Files) — this is primary navigation - ❌ Did NOT use too-small touch targets — all buttons stay accessible on mobile - ❌ Did NOT force horizontal scrolling — toolbar stacks vertically when needed
